description: Add a 'Switch vault' button to the Ribbon so users can return to the VaultPicker after opening the demo vault (or any vault). Also add desktop-readiness polish: proper frameless window title bar drag region, app name in title bar area.
steps: In src/components/vault/Ribbon.tsx, add a 'Switch vault' or 'Close vault' button at the very bottom of the ribbon (below Settings), using the Vault icon (lucide-react's Vault or FolderSync or ArrowLeftRight or LogOut icon). The button calls useVaultStore's closeVault() action. Add a Tooltip with side='right' saying 'Switch vault'. Use the same styling pattern as other ribbon buttons (w-10 h-10 flex items-center justify-center rounded-md text-sidebar-foreground/70 hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground transition-colors).

In src/components/vault/VaultApp.tsx, add a title bar drag region div at the very top of the app (inside the flex column, before the resizable panel group). This should be a thin bar (h-8) with -webkit-app-region: drag CSS for Electron frameless window dragging. It should display the vault name (from useVaultStore handle.name). Use 'no-drag' regions for any interactive elements. Only render the drag region when running in Electron (check window.electronAPI or navigator.userAgent for Electron, or simply use CSS that is harmless in browser).

In main.js, ensure the BrowserWindow config has frame: false (or keep titleBarStyle: 'hiddenInset' on macOS) for a proper frameless desktop app feel. The current config already uses titleBarStyle: 'hiddenInset' which is good for macOS. Add platform-specific handling: on Windows/Linux use frame: false with a custom title bar; on macOS keep hiddenInset.
Verify that bun run lint passes with no new errors.
acceptance_criteria: A 'Switch vault' button is visible in the Ribbon (bottom area) that calls closeVault() when clicked
After clicking 'Switch vault', the app returns to VaultPicker where user can open a local folder or re-enter demo
The app has a proper drag region for Electron desktop window movement
bun run lint passes with zero errors
verification: Run bun run lint and confirm zero errors
Read the modified Ribbon.tsx and confirm it imports closeVault from useVaultStore and has a button calling it
